summary: Suspension contact-geometry update for a vehicle physics node, gated by a distance threshold (this+0x12C must be below dword_5EA2CC). Computes the delta vector (this+0xA4/0xA8/0xAC) from the local reference position to a linked neighbor (primary this+0x110, falling back to alternative this+0x10C), derives lateral bounds (this+0x50/0x54), combined coordinates (this+0x68/0x6C) and the delta magnitude (this+0x3C), normalizes the delta, computes a secondary distance (this+0x40) from the tertiary pointer this+0x114, and sets an approach angle (this+0xB8) from atan2 with pi/2 and +pi special cases. Finally it propagates clamped cosine-similarity values into the this+0xBC array through a chain of up to 4 linked physics nodes.

local_names.v11: chained neighbor cursor during propagation loop

operations.description: Distance threshold guard: the whole geometry update only runs when the node's distance state this+0x12C is below dword_5EA2CC.

Primary-source delta: when the linked-neighbor pointer this+0x110 is set, compute the delta vector (this+0xA4/0xA8/0xAC) as neighbor reference position (offsets 0x94/0x98/0x9C) minus the local reference position (this+0x94/0x98/0x9C).
Fallback-source delta: when this+0x110 is null but the alternative pointer this+0x10C is set, copy the delta vector (this+0xA4/0xA8/0xAC) from the alternative object's offsets 0xA4/0xA8/0xAC.
Bounds: compute the lower/upper bounds this+0x50 / this+0x54 from the base position this+0x2C / this+0x30 minus 1.5, plus/minus the half-width this+0xA0.
Combined coordinates: this+0x68 / this+0x6C = offset this+0x60 / this+0x64 plus base position this+0x2C / this+0x30.
Magnitude: this+0x3C = sqrt(delta_x^2 + delta_y^2 + delta_z^2) over the delta vector this+0xA4/0xA8/0xAC.
Zero-delta guard: skip normalization when all three delta components (this+0xA4/0xA8/0xAC) are 0.0.
Normalize: divide each delta component by its magnitude, writing the unit vector back to this+0xA4/0xA8/0xAC.

Secondary distance: when the tertiary pointer this+0x114 is set, compute this+0x40 = sqrt of the summed squared deltas between the tertiary reference position (offsets 0x94/0x98/0x9C) and the local reference position (this+0x94/0x98/0x9C).
Approach angle: when delta Z (this+0xAC) is 0.0 set the angle this+0xB8 to 1.5708 (pi/2); otherwise this+0xB8 = atan2(delta_x / delta_z, 1.0), adding 3.1415927 (pi) when delta Z is positive.

Chain propagation: iterate up to 4 chained neighbors starting at the next pointer *(this+0x110)+0x110 and further *(*(this+0x110)+0x110)+0x110; for each, compute the cosine similarity between the unit delta and the neighbor relative vector (offsets 0x94/0x9C), pass it through FloatFunctionPassThrough, clamp to the minimum 0.024110001, and store into the this+0xBC array entries.
Reads the five float constant globals that back the inline literals (1.5, 1.5708, 3.1415927, 0.024110001, 1.0) used across the geometry math; the exact constant-to-global mapping is not evidenced.
